name: Another
source:
This game is based on a Japanese mystery horror novel by Yukito Ayatsuji, published on October 29, 2009 by Kadokawa Shoten.

The game focuses on a boy named... who, upon transferring into YK Middle School and meeting the curious Mei Misaki, finds himself in a mystery revolving around students and people related to his class facing gruesome, senseless deaths.
translation:
本作改编自绫辻行人的日本推理恐怖小说，该小说由角川书店于2009年10月29日出版。

故事聚焦于一名男孩——当他转入夜见北中学、遇到神秘的见崎鸣后，发现自己卷入了一起谜案：与自己班级相关的学生和人员接连遭遇惨烈而毫无意义的死亡。
